regions.name: Hokkaido
visual_identifiers: very wide straight roads unlike rest of Japan
much lower population density than Honshu
wide open agricultural landscape unusual for Japan

state_distinguishers.Hokkaido: Only island with this feel — wide roads, grid cities, dairy farms, completely unlike the rest of Japan. Very distinctive.

regions.route_sign_clues: Hokkaido uses specific route numbering. Wide roads are the biggest giveaway.
regions.gemini_hint: Wide straight roads + grid city + dairy farms + lavender = Hokkaido almost certainly. This is the most distinctive Japanese island from a GeoGuessr perspective.
common_false_positives: Snow — also in northern Honshu in winter

regions.name: Honshu North (Tohoku)

state_distinguishers.Miyagi: Sendai city infrastructure, more developed than other Tohoku
state_distinguishers.Aomori: Northernmost Honshu, apple orchards, Aomori city port

regions.route_sign_clues: National Route numbers. Tohoku Expressway runs through region.
regions.gemini_hint: Rice paddies + mountains + traditional rural = Tohoku or central Honshu. Wide roads and dairy = Hokkaido not Tohoku.
common_false_positives: Forested mountains — hard to distinguish from central Japan

regions.name: Honshu Central (Kanto and Chubu)
visual_identifiers: Mount Fuji visible from multiple prefectures

state_distinguishers.Tokyo_metro: Most dense urban in world, very specific Tokyo infrastructure
state_distinguishers.Nagano: Japan Alps, ski resort infrastructure, very mountainous
state_distinguishers.Shizuoka: Mount Fuji visible, tea plantation rows distinctive

regions.route_sign_clues: Tomei Expressway through Shizuoka/Aichi. Chuo Expressway through Nagano.
regions.gemini_hint: Mount Fuji visible = Shizuoka or Yamanashi. Tea plantation rows = Shizuoka. Japan Alps = Nagano. Most dense urban = Tokyo or Osaka area.
common_false_positives: Dense urban — hard to distinguish Tokyo from Osaka metro visually

regions.name: Honshu West (Kansai and Chugoku)
visual_identifiers: Osaka urban density second to Tokyo
Tottori sand dunes — unique in Japan

state_distinguishers.Kyoto: Traditional temple and shrine architecture very distinctive
state_distinguishers.Tottori: Sand dunes — only place in Japan
state_distinguishers.Hiroshima: Peace dome area, specific city layout

regions.route_sign_clues: Meishin Expressway through Kansai. San-yo Expressway through Chugoku.
regions.gemini_hint: Traditional temple architecture = Kyoto almost certainly. Sand dunes = Tottori only. Seto Inland Sea island views = Hiroshima or Okayama.
common_false_positives: Urban density — hard to distinguish Osaka from other large cities

regions.name: Shikoku and Kyushu

state_distinguishers.Kagoshima: Sakurajima volcano visible — completely unique identifier
state_distinguishers.Nagasaki: Hilly port city, specific Nagasaki architecture, peace memorial area
state_distinguishers.Oita: Beppu hot spring steam vents, onsen infrastructure very visible

regions.route_sign_clues: Kyushu Expressway network. Ferry infrastructure for Shikoku.
regions.gemini_hint: Active volcano visible = Kagoshima/Sakurajima. Steam vents and onsen = Oita/Beppu. Very mountainous rural = Shikoku or Kyushu interior.
common_false_positives: Subtropical vegetation — also in southern Honshu
